# 1.38.0-beta.1

First beta of 1.38.0: prompt caching.

## Caching

- Caching now works with every provider that allows it. Claude and Qwen through OpenRouter, Qwen directly and Claude on your own server used to run with no cache at all, so long chats and agents paid the full price for the whole history on every request.
- Each chat and each agent now has its own cache, which lasts through pauses of up to 5 minutes. The provider recognizes the conversation and reads the part it has already seen at a much lower price instead of processing it again.
- Agents that work in windows and on web pages keep their cache too, even though older screenshots and pages are shortened as they work.
- One-off requests such as chat titles and routing no longer pay extra to store text that will never be read again.
- If a server does not accept the cache fields, the request is sent again without them and the model keeps its reasoning.
- Cleaning up old messages no longer breaks a live cache. Stale file versions are now removed after a pause, when the cache has expired anyway, or every few messages in a fast conversation.

## Chat

- The model no longer has to retype files. To show a text or code file it has opened in the chat, it names the file and the program puts the text into a code block. This costs less, and the block shows exactly what is in the file. A shown file stays as it was at the moment of the answer.

## Spending

- Estimated spending for direct providers now counts cached tokens at the cached price, and cache writes at the write price, wherever the price catalog names them.
- Agent work on direct providers is now priced in dollars too. It used to be recorded in tokens only.
